findings.claim_reviewed: the proposed addition says VOPP1 Y165A 'abolishes' the co-IP
findings.finding: 'Abolished' is the authors' word for WWOX Y33R, not for VOPP1 Y165A. Their text for Y165 is hedged: 'WWOX-VOPP1 interaction was strongly affected by the mutation of tyrosine 165', concluding the motif 'was required to sustain a robust interaction'. The panel does show lane 8 blank, so 'abolishes' is defensible as a pixel reading, but the candidate's own manifest entry 10 flags the hedge and the canon-facing sentence then drops the flag.
findings.direction: OVERSHOOT — canon would carry a strength the source's prose declines to assert, in the very claim BATCH_20260914_005 repaired for overshooting.

findings.claim_reviewed: 'of VOPP1's three PPxY motifs only Y165A abolishes it while Y119A retains binding'
findings.finding: The sentence names two of three mutants. Y157A is omitted from the canon text while the same candidate's §4 records it: 'Y157A partially impairs binding (Figure 1e lane 7, reduced but present doublet)'. I re-rendered Figure 1 myself at 430 dpi rather than take the producer's attestation: IP:Myc/IB:Flag shows lane 3 strong, lane 5 (Y33R) essentially blank, lane 6 (Y119A) strong, lane 7 (Y157A) a clearly reduced but plainly present doublet, lane 8 (Y165A) blank; the WCL/IB:Flag row carries Flag signal in lanes 2,3,5,6,7,8, so lane 7 is not an expression artefact.
findings.direction: UNDERSHOOT of the paper's content toward tidiness — a reader infers a clean one-of-three result where the panel shows a graded result across three motifs.

findings.severity: count stated as exhaustive and found short
findings.claim_reviewed: "'global' is modified by 'lung' in both places the authors use it"
findings.finding: Three places, not two, and the omitted one is a Results section heading: (1) Introduction 'global lung silencing of WWOX'; (2) heading 'Global loss of murine lung WWOX expression causes neutrophilic alveolitis'; (3) Discussion 'acute, global knockdown of lung WWOX expression'. All three are lung-scoped.
findings.direction: The conclusion is CORRECT and BROADER than claimed. Recorded because an exhaustive count found short is how a true finding later gets contested, and the omitted instance is the string a skimming reader hits first.

findings.finding: It occurs twice, both inside the journal title 'Brain Res' in reference 36. There is genuinely no brain, neuron, seizure or developmental endpoint in the paper, so the no-transfer conclusion stands, but a string-absence assertion must be tested before it is written and this one fails its own test.
findings.direction: No effect on the delta; a discipline finding.

findings.severity: PRINCIPAL FINDING — the source is mischaracterised
findings.claim_reviewed: PMID 33058734 as 'the negative', and 'no experiment in either paper measures the other's compartment'
findings.finding: PMID 33058734 is a SPLIT result, not a negative. Its own legends: Figure 3 'EC-specific WWOX KO mice exhibit greater vascular leak during LPS-induced ARDS'; Figure 5 the same for MRSA; Figure 8 'ECs isolated from EC WWOX KO mice produce more cytokines during MRSA exposure' with *P<0.05; against Figure 4 and Figure 6 'do not exhibit greater BAL cytokines'. Its abstract: 'EC WWOX KO mice exhibited significantly greater levels of vascular leak and histologic lung injury.' Its Introduction built the EC model FROM Singla's disproportion: '...out of proportion to increases in inflammation (20). This raised the question of whether an inflammation-independent mechanism of endothelial barrier vulnerability was a part of the WWOX-deficient phenotype.' So the sequel CONFIRMS the endothelial-barrier inference PMID 28283473's Discussion drew, and fails to reproduce only its inflammatory leg in that compartment. The '24 bars' count is true of Figures 4 and 6 only.
findings.direction: The candidate's conclusion (the two do not impeach each other's INFLAMMATORY phenotype) survives; the framing inverts the relationship on the leak axis. The dispatch's own framing — 'the endothelium the sequel found null' — is wrong the same way.

findings.severity: factual error in the confound list
findings.claim_reviewed: 'chronic, endothelium-restricted' and 'perturbation type, compartment and duration differ simultaneously'
findings.finding: Duration does not differ. The EC KO arm is tamoxifen 75 mg/kg for 5 consecutive days, then 'Seven days later' the stimulus, then 18 hours to harvest — the same acute 18 h window as Singla's. 'Chronic' in PMID 33058734 belongs to a separate WILD-TYPE e-cigarette arm ('1 hour a day, 5 days a week, and for 3 months') in which no WWOX allele is manipulated.
findings.direction: Two variables differ (perturbation type, compartment), not three. A confound list with a spurious member is weaker than an accurate shorter one, because the spurious member is the one a reader tries to vary first.

findings.severity: regression of a correction already paid for
findings.finding: CC-20260913-ALDAZ-C003-01 §146 already WITHDREW the clean single-variable framing of this pair, citing Figure 8 by name: 'that ex-vivo positive is under an infectious stimulus, so stimulus alone cannot separate positive from null. The bound is now stimulus AND compartment.' Candidate 2 §4 re-introduces a positive-leg-versus-negative-leg reading the day after.
findings.direction: Landing as drafted would regress a correction this laboratory already made.

ratchet_proposed_for_delta_E.why_no_current_check_sees_it: session_self_eval.unread_premises() clears a citation on any of three grounds — a receipt, a registry full-text declaration, or a full-text-queue entry — and fires only on UNREAD premises. PMID 30285739 was cleared throughout, because a CORPUS-STUB is a paper_registry record. Being recorded and being LINKED to the claim one supports are different properties and only the first is measured; nothing compares 'papers a live claim leans on' against 'papers whose record carries a Claim links entry for that claim'.
ratchet_proposed_for_delta_E.shape: For every CLAIM, extract PMIDs named in Summary, Source and Evidence boundary; resolve each in paper_registry by Identifier; flag any whose record is a CORPUS-STUB or whose Claim links does not name that claim. Report as UNLINKED_SUPPORT, one line per pair.
ratchet_proposed_for_delta_E.properties_to_keep: A cross-check, not a counter — reports UNCHECKED rather than blocking when an identifier will not resolve, and keys on the Claim links field rather than on prose. A count-based ratchet would baseline whatever today's unlinked set happens to be.
ratchet_proposed_for_delta_E.owner: Harness Engineering at T0. Not implemented by me: framework/ is not a surface this dispatch gives me.
